deoxygenation_method: N2 sparging of solvent prior to reaction

streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Substrates dissolved in solvent. Split total flow equally for mixing.
From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Catalyst and base mixed separately to prevent precipitation. Split total flow equally.

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: Base and catalyst mixed separately to avoid immediate precipitation of Pd species before contact with substrates. T-mixer provides rapid mixing for laminar flow.
pre_reactor_steps: Sparging DMF with N2 for 15 min prior to pumping to remove dissolved oxygen (Chemistry Plan: deoxygenation_required=true).
post_reactor_steps: Collection into vial under inert atmosphere.
chemistry_notes: CRITICAL CONSTRAINT VIOLATION: Batch requires 50°C, but all available PFA tubing/reactors are rated max 40°C. Design proposes operating at 40°C (max safe limit) to preserve hardware integrity, acknowledging potential yield drop vs batch. Reaction is thermal Suzuki coupling, not photochemical; light_setup is null. Deoxygenation is critical for Pd(0) stability. Stream separation prevents Pd-base precipitation.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation Step 2 estimated 0.6 min. Analogy 1 used 12 min but was photoredox/SET; this is thermal Pd-catalyzed. Thermal couplings are faster. Using 0.6 min based on calculation and kinetic class IF.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Single-phase liquid system. Basis is liquid volume / liquid flow.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Batch is 50°C. Inventory max is 40°C. Hard constraint violation. Set to 40°C to prevent tubing failure. Yield may be lower than batch.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8: BPR not required. DMF bp (153°C) >> 40°C. No gas generation.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: Inventory only provides PFA. PFA is suitable for thermal reactions up to 40°C. FEP not available in inventory.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Calculation Step 1 used 0.1 M. Analogy 1 used 0.05 M. Using 0.1 M to maximize productivity within solubility limits.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Selected 5 mL PFA coil from inventory. Smallest available. 10 mL is too large for short residence times.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Adjusted to 5.0 mL/min to achieve tau ~1 min with 5 mL reactor (Inventory constraint). Max pump capacity is 5.0 mL/min.
